title: Asymptotic Behavior of Least Energy Solutions to the Lane--Emden Problem on Metric Graphs
summary: In this paper, we study the asymptotic behavior of least energy solutions to Lane--Emden problems on compact metric graphs as $p \to \infty$. For the problem with Dirichlet--Kirchhoff boundary conditions, we characterize the limiting variational problem in terms of the Dirichlet--Kirchhoff Green function and show that least energy positive solutions converge, up to a subsequence, to a normalized Green function centered at a maximizer of the diagonal Green function.
